citations.quote:
[name="帕斯卡拉"]……有什么我能做的事情吗？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1581_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="胡安娜"]哦，小丫头，我很高兴又看到你活蹦乱跳的样子。
[multiline(name="胡安娜")]修补船体，加固桅杆，还有处理食物……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1581_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="胡安娜")]来吧，我们需要干的事情多着呢。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avgnew_400_weedy_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="温蒂"]修船的事情有小叶帮忙，要不还是让她再躺一会儿吧……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4163_rosesa_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕斯卡拉"]……我不要。
[name="帕斯卡拉"]昨天那样我都没事，晚上没有撞上骸骨，也没有被盐鳞顶飞，现在还有水喝……
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[multiline(name="帕斯卡拉")]咳……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4163_rosesa_1#16$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="帕斯卡拉")]我要做点什么……做点什么让我自己活着回去！
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1581_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="胡安娜"]来吧，把手给我，我拉你起来。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1581_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovementsp", volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="胡安娜"]——嘿！
